name: TechnipFMC plc
moat_justification: A real technology and integration position in subsea (iEPCI, Subsea 2.0, direct-award flow, services installed base) that has demonstrably expanded margins this cycle, but no protection against the operator-capex cycle itself — earnings collapsed in the last downturn — and credible integrated competitors (SLB's OneSubsea, Baker Hughes) contest every award.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 2.3%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 3.30 vs 3-yr median 1.41 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.4x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Quality subsea franchise, moat 5/10, but at $69.50 the price pays for the recovery and more — weighted IRR 6.12%, weighted IV@15 $18.16 on the normalized base; clears 15% only at or below $18.16, and even the super-bull IV is $37.56.
moat_for: iEPCI integrated model and Subsea 2.0 configurable technology
Direct awards, iEPCI and Subsea Services were >80% of 2025 Subsea inbound (company release)
$15.9B Subsea backlog at FY2025 year-end plus services tail on the installed base
Proven margin expansion: Adj. EBITDA margin 18.4% FY2025, Subsea 23.2% in Q2 2026
moat_against: Hostage to offshore operator capex cycle — net income negative in 2018-2020
Integrated competition from SLB OneSubsea and Baker Hughes
Backlog flat year over year at Q2 2026 — orders replacing executed work, not compounding
Surface Technologies shrinking (revenue -13.3% YoY in Q2 2026)
Long-run energy-transition shrinkage of the offshore market; project/geopolitical execution risk
